Name: Even More Secret Woods
Author: Kaoak
Description:
Hi!

This is my first mod, it adds a new area to the secret woods. I added some stumps, a hidden lake, an abandonned house and some
bushes and trees. The entrance is a secret path below the less secret area of the woods, see image for reference. If you search a bit you will
find some secret paths!

If you want to use this mod on a saved game, install [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/resources/smapi-entoarox-framework.4228/]Entoarox Framework[/url] and [b]type [code]world_reset bushes
[/code] in the SMAPI console[/b].
If you are using the multiplayer beta version, install the temporary
little mod BushReset I made from Entoarox Framework and type [code]world_reset bushes
[/code] in the SMAPI console. (link in Optional Files)
You will have to sleep a night to see the new stumps appearing.

[b]Changelog :
[/b][u]v1.2 :[/u]
I decided to make the map a bit more lively and corrected the entrance of a secret path, [b]please run the [code]world_reset bushes
[/code] command once again
after updating the mod[/b] to get it to work.

-Added a little clearing inspired by a certain in-game character.
-Added two hidden messages to find in the secret paths.
-Added a function to the abandonned house : by right-clicking on the broken door you'll see your stats.

[b]**Do not edit, trace, or redistribute this mod without my express permission.[/b]

[b](Recommended) Install EvenMoreSecretWoods with SMAPI and Content Patcher: [/b]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2. Download the mod
3. Extract .zip file
4. Copy/move the "EvenMoreSecretWoods" folder into the mods file. It
should be in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew
Valley\Mods
5. You're done!

[b]Install [b]EvenMoreSecretWoods [/b]XNB style: [/b]
1. Download the mod
2. Extract the .zip file
3. Locate your Stardew Valley>Content>Maps folder
4. Copy/move the woods.xnb file into the Maps folder and [b]REPLACE [/b]it
5. You're done!

[b]WARNING [/b]: If you are using the multiplayer beta version, this installation will
cause harm to your game, use the Content Patcher method instead.

I want to thank Pathoschild, F4ith, EmissaryOfInfinity and all the modding
channel of the SDV discord for their precious help and patience with my
noob questions.
